name: Assessment
definition: Measuring performance against a defined standard.

name: Clinical implementation
definition: Putting a validated intervention into routine practice.

name: Clinical judgment
definition: Practising assessment and decision-making rather than manual technique.

name: Clinical simulation
definition: Rehearsing a whole clinical scenario, including decisions and team response.

name: Communication
definition: Practising clinical conversation and information exchange.

name: Hardware platform
definition: Acting as the device other software is delivered on.

name: Home care
definition: Use by a patient at home rather than in a clinical setting.

name: Just-in-time practice
definition: A short rehearsal immediately before performing the real procedure.

name: Motor learning
definition: Acquiring and refining movement through structured practice.

name: Networking
definition: Meeting peers and building professional connections.

name: Patient communication
definition: Explaining a condition or procedure to a patient or family.

name: Planning
definition: Preparing an intervention in advance of performing it.

name: Product training
definition: Training clinicians on a specific device or product.

name: Progress monitoring
definition: Tracking measurable change over a course of treatment.

name: Regulatory reference
definition: Consulting an official regulatory record.

name: Remote assistance
definition: A remote expert guiding someone on site.

name: Remote care
definition: Delivering care or supervision at a distance.

name: Research
definition: Investigation intended to produce generalisable knowledge.

name: Research exchange
definition: Sharing findings between research groups.

name: Skills training
definition: Repeated practice of a procedure or technique to build competence.

name: Team training
definition: Practising coordination, handover, and communication between clinicians.

name: Technology scouting
definition: Surveying the field for emerging capability.

name: Therapy support
definition: Delivering or supporting a therapeutic intervention.

name: Training
definition: General instruction and practice.

name: Visualization
definition: Making structures or data visible and inspectable in three dimensions.

name: AR
definition: Digital content overlaid on the real world, leaving the surroundings visible.

name: Haptics
definition: Force or tactile feedback that lets the user feel resistance, texture, or contact.

name: MR
definition: Digital and physical content that occupy the same space and can interact with each other.

name: Screen-based
definition: Immersive content delivered on an ordinary monitor rather than a headset, often for throughput or accessibility.

name: VR
definition: Fully virtual environments viewed in a headset, replacing the user's view of the room.

name: Behavioral health
definition: Mental health and behavioural intervention, including anxiety and exposure work.

name: Cardiology
definition: Diagnosis and treatment of heart and vascular conditions.

name: Clinical research
definition: Structured investigation of clinical questions.

name: Cross-specialty
definition: Applies across clinical disciplines rather than to one specialty.

name: Dentistry
definition: Dental and oral procedures and training.

name: Electrophysiology
definition: Study and treatment of the heart's electrical activity, including catheter ablation for arrhythmias.

name: Emergency care
definition: Acute and emergency clinical response.

name: Human factors
definition: How people interact with systems, devices, and each other under clinical conditions.

name: Medical devices
definition: Regulated instruments and equipment used in care.

name: Medical education
definition: Teaching and assessment of clinical knowledge and skills.

name: Medical imaging
definition: Acquisition and processing of clinical images such as CT and MRI.

name: Military medicine
definition: Care delivered in military and field settings.

name: Neurodiversity
definition: Support for autistic people and others whose cognition differs from the typical, including social and communication skills practice.

name: Neurology
definition: Conditions of the brain, spinal cord, and nervous system, including stroke and neurodegenerative disease.

name: Neurosurgery
definition: Surgery of the brain, spine, and nervous system.

name: Nursing
definition: Nursing practice, education, and clinical skills.

name: Orthopedics
definition: Musculoskeletal surgery and care.

name: Otolaryngology
definition: Ear, nose, and throat medicine and surgery, including endoscopic sinus and temporal bone procedures.

name: Pain management
definition: Assessment and treatment of acute and chronic pain.

name: Radiology
definition: Medical imaging and image interpretation.

name: Rehabilitation
definition: Restoring function and movement after injury, surgery, or illness.

name: Spine surgery
definition: Surgical treatment of spinal conditions.

name: Surgery
definition: Operative practice across surgical disciplines.

name: 3D reconstruction
definition: Turning medical images such as CT or MRI into interactive three-dimensional models.

name: Eye tracking
definition: Sensors that follow where the user is looking, used for interaction and for attention measurement.

name: Inside-out tracking
definition: Position tracking from cameras on the headset itself, with no external sensors to install.

name: Learning analytics
definition: Capturing performance data across learners to show progress and gaps.

name: Multiplayer
definition: Several people present in the same virtual session at once, from different locations.

name: Passthrough
definition: Cameras that show the real room inside a headset, enabling mixed reality on an otherwise opaque device.
